summary: FD_TC_095_No Determination | Disruption on OAL | APPR
title: No Determination | Disruption on OAL | APPR
description:
Disrupted leg operated by a non-Star Alliance carrier (e.g., WestJet). AC systems have the flight timing data (scheduled vs. actual arrival times, delay duration) and can identify the MSL. DDS determines MSL = WestJet-operated leg. Since WestJet is not a Star Alliance partner, AC is not responsible for the disruption. The system redirects the customer to contact WestJet directly. No case is created, no DDS eligibility assessment is performed, and no compensation is issued. Validates the OAL redirect path when MSL falls on a non-Star Alliance carrier.

Prerequisites:
PNR: Single passenger, 2 legs YUL?YYZ?YVR.
Leg 1 (YUL?YYZ): AC operated, on time. Scheduled arrival: 10:30. Actual arrival: 10:28.
Leg 2 (YYZ?YVR): Operated by WestJet (WS 3456). Scheduled arrival: 16:00. Actual arrival: 21:00 (5hr delay).
MSL: Leg 2 (WS 3456) � 5hr delay is the most significant disruption.
MSL Carrier: WestJet (WS) � non-Star Alliance.
DDS Action: MSL identified on non-Star Alliance OAL ? AC not responsible ? redirect to OAL.
